messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: PROD-DB-CONN-SURGE — severity: P1 — 3 triggers in 2m. Incident: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98765

pagerduty-bot: PD incident created and page fired to oncall (Maya R.). Escalation policy: db-oncall -> eng-sre.

Maya R.: acked. I'll coordinate. starting collection of metrics and logs.

Sanjay K.: I'm looking at Datadog: redis maxclients hitting 10000 (limit=10000) and blocked_clients ~1200. redis latency p95 ~420ms, p99 ~890ms. PG numbackends jumping from 180 -> 620, pgbouncer queueing visible.

Alex P.: seeing elevated 503s on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Errors: connection pool exhausted in app logs, and streaming timeouts.

Tanya L.: customer support report: a few enterprise customers on dedicated are seeing timeouts for embeddings ingest. Escalated to CS.

Sanjay K.: snippets:
```
# redis-cli -h redis-cache-1 info clients | egrep "blocked_clients|maxclients|connected_clients"
connected_clients:9823
blocked_clients:1221
maxclients:10000
```
```
-- psql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle';
 count
------
  602
(1 row)
```

Maya R.: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttling at edge for heavy concurrent streaming routes (reduce simultaneous DB work), 2) scale pgbouncer, 3) bump read replica/pgbouncer instances if safe, 4) toggle application connection pool down temporarily (feature flag).

Leo W.: I'll scale pgbouncer now (rolling) -> `kubectl scale deploy pgbouncer -n infra --replicas=4` then monitor.

Leo W.: scaled to 4, pods rolling, new connections being accepted. Watching queue length.

Sanjay K.: caution on bumping redis maxclients — OS fd limits + evictions. Suggest we relieve pressure instead of enlarging cap. Can we enable prefix caching TTL for embeddings to reduce DB hits?

Alex P.: enabling short-term client-side backoff in gateway (feature flag `client_conn_backoff=true`) now. Will drop concurrency from 25 -> 8 per connection for affected route.

Tanya L.: CS: sending notification to impacted customers in us-west-2 saying we are investigating degraded latency and timeouts. No PII exposed.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: automatic escalation triggered (no ack from SRE lead) — paging lead (Sanjay K.).

Sanjay K.: ack escalation. I'm running a quick query to identify long-running queries: `SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 10;` a few bulk ingest jobs stuck in `idle in transaction` holding connections.

Maya R.: action: kill the top 2 offending pids after checking application retry behaviour. If we drop them, will the clients retry aggressively? Alex?

Alex P.: those two are from an ingestion worker that's retrying aggressively. If we kill, it will reconnect but we'll keep backoff enabled. Good tradeoff. Approving kill.

Sanjay K.: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(XXXXX);` executed on two long-running pids. Connections freed ~2min after kills. pg numbackends dropped to ~420.

Leo W.: redis blocked_clients dropping to ~300 after gateway backoff + pgbouncer scale. redis p95 latency down to ~150ms. API 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.

Tanya L.: still seeing a small cohort of 504s for streaming sessions. CS: partial mitigation message updated.

Maya R.: summary so far — root cause likely a reconnect/infinite-retry storm from an ingestion job combined with a recent traffic spike causing connection pileup to both Redis and Postgres. Mitigations applied: gateway backoff flag, pgbouncer scaled, terminated stuck PG sessions, temporary client throttle.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-98765 -> acknowledged by Maya R., Sanjay K., Leo W.

Maya R.: moving to short Handoff: Tanya, please take lead for 30m follow-up and verification. I'll stay on-call for RCA. Create ticket and attach logs.

Tanya L.: taking over. creating incident ticket: INC-98765-WIP. adding runbook tags: db-conn-surge, redis-maxclients, pgbouncer. Notes: capture flamegraphs, slow query log, redis slowlog, and app-side connection churn metrics.

Sanjay K.: post-incident immediate actions: 1) add circuit-breaker on ingestion worker, 2) add slower reconnect jitter, 3) add Datadog alert for blocked_clients > 500 for 2m, 4) update runbook with step-by-step kill guidance and safety checks.

Alex P.: rollback plan if mitigation causes regressions: revert `client_conn_backoff` flag, scale down pgbouncer if needed. I'll coordinate with deploybot.

Maya R.: customer impact note for postmortem: "A subset of customers in us-west-2 experienced elevated 5xx (3-6% of requests) and increased latency for streaming endpoints between 1743219999 and 1743220600 UTC. Mitigations restored stable behavior by ~1743220500 UTC. No data loss observed."

Tanya L.: handing to oncall rotation: I'm keeping this in active watch for 60m. Will collect logs and produce RCA draft. Assign followups: INC-98765-FIXES.

Maya R.: thanks team. create follow-up PRs: 1) ingestion retry circuit-breaker, 2) add client jitter & cap, 3) update runbook. We'll schedule RCA review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-98765 marked as "stabilized" by Maya R. — monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: PD incident closed (auto) — please file RCA within 48h.

Tanya L.: noted. I'll attach collected artifacts: dd graphs, redis slowlog extracts, pgbouncer stats, killed pids, and CS timeline to the ticket.

Maya R.: handoff complete. leaving notes in ticket for priority follow-ups.
